description: Tracked known package defects tolerated by the fast PR gate (guard:packages / verify:metadata) so the FIX-011 guardrails could land while the underlying fixes are still in flight. Every entry MUST reference the remediation-program FIX id that will remove it. The enforced end-state of every list in this file is EMPTY: when a fix lands, the corresponding entries stop reproducing and the gate fails with a 'stale allowlist entry' error until they are deleted. Removing an entry is a one-line deletion. See issues_to_Fix.md and docs/release-incident-2026-08-13.md.
